title: stage.yaml — one pipeline stage shipped by a stage pack

kind.description: agents: dispatch the listed agents; task_loop: per-task red/green routed by role

agents.description: bare agent name (same pack), <pack>:<agent>, or role:<slot> resolved through enabled roles

inputs.description: artifact types; suffix ? marks optional; a|b means either

writes.description: extra globs (project-relative) the stage's agents may write besides its outputs

gate.description: engine gate name, a list of them (all must pass), or null

on_fail.description: retry in place; block; goto:<stage> rewinds; fix:<stage> rewinds with the failures as fix items for the planner

when.description: condition key; the stage is skipped when it evaluates false

modes.description: entry modes this stage runs in; omitted = all

owners.description: artifact type → the one agent of this stage that writes it; others may not

on_reject.description: what a human reject at this stage's gate does (default: re-run the stage)

after_pass.description: engine action when the gate passes: ship = commit plan + PR; triage_fixes = PR comments classified as change become fix items; lock_acceptance = hash the feature's acceptance tests so no later phase can change them

read_deny.description: globs the stage's agents may not read (black-box roles)

before.description: engine work before the stage's agents run: scaffold copies each role's boilerplate into its folder and installs dependencies

on_approve.description: spec_delta: approving the human gate with breaking spec deltas in the prototype report sends the feature back to requirements

review.description: artifact refs shown to the human at this stage's gate besides its outputs (e.g. GATE-B shows the architecture)

exit_check.description: false: the pack names no exit check (read-only agents whose gate needs files the engine writes after them)

precheck.description: a gate the engine runs before dispatching the stage's agents (outside the lock); its fix: true failures go straight to the on_fail fix target

audits.description: roles: the engine runs every enabled role's gates.audits on the change set and adds their findings to the review

models.description: agent → model for this stage only (the patch tier plans on sonnet)
